newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy cabinet discusses pensions, no details.
newsitem.headline: Italy cabinet discusses pensions, no details.

text.p: Italy's cabinet discussed reforms of the welfare state at a meeting on Thursday, but an official statement gave no details of the discussions.

"The cabinet held a wide and detailed discussion on the general outlines of reforms of the welfare state which will be examined in more depth in talks with (union leaders and employers)," a government statement said.
The meeting approved measures to simplify sales and car taxes and two international accords, one on cooperation with Guyana and one on relations between European Union countries and Slovenia.
The government is expected to outline more details of welfare reform next week when it is due to release its three-year programme of economic forecasts, known as the DPEF.
